metadata._comment: MCP server metadata block — MatPlotLibNet.Mcp targets net10.0 only (a dotnet tool is resolved through the .NET 10 SDK), so it cannot ride the net8.0 block above.

WPF metadata block — re-enabled 2026-04-19 after MatPlotLibNet.Wpf.csproj added <EnableWindowsTargeting Condition="'$(OS)' != 'Windows_NT'">true</EnableWindowsTargeting>. DocFX can now extract net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0 metadata on Linux CI without installing the Windows desktop runtime.

build._comment_sitemap: Every page is listed, but not every page is equally worth crawling: 729 of the 765 urls are generated API reference pages, and they were competing for crawl attention with the 34 cookbook pages people actually search for. fileOptions ranks them.

globalMetadata._comment_canonical: No _canonicalUrlPrefix here on purpose: measured against docfx 2.78.5 with the default+modern template, it emits no <link rel="canonical"> at all (0 of 767 built pages). Only three pages are reachable under two addresses — the site root, the cookbook index and the api index, each served for both /x/ and /x/index.html — and the sitemap names one form of each. Making canonical real needs a forked copy of docfx's head partial, which is a bigger maintenance debt than the three pages are worth.
